### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, touching **81** documentable anchor(s).

**38** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `environmentId (38 routes)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **10** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2173b1df02ad189278fb4507b3f5b15513b1378c` — the merge of head `044b4d97de892c2ad6277961ee43b27a56f1dd0d` into base `aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2173b1df02ad189278fb4507b3f5b15513b1378c && git checkout 2173b1df02ad189278fb4507b3f5b15513b1378c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8 044b4d97de892c2ad6277961ee43b27a56f1dd0d && git checkout -B drift-repro aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8 && git merge --no-ff 044b4d97de892c2ad6277961ee43b27a56f1dd0d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs aef631b80b3175f2f43287a6e0185c828c356ac8` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿)

- 改了什么：`protocol.ts` 里 22 个私有方法的方法体原样搬进 8 个按主题划分的新模块，类上的方法、签名、文档注释和位置都不变，只剩一行调用。
- 为什么改：#25467 拆分超大文件 `protocol.ts` 的第 33 刀（#24586 裁决 A）。所有剩余私有成员都筛过一遍，这一刀把能搬的全部搬完，私有成员这条线到此搬尽。
- 风险与回滚：低。方法体逐 token 相同，发布的 `.d.ts` 与 main 字节相同，没有调用点改动；回滚就是还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`protocol.ts` 里带 `[#25467 cut 33]` 的 22 个桩方法，以及 `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts` 新增的 4 行 `PRODUCERS`（5 处 `new Error(` 随方法体搬走，扫描跟着搬）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts src/protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无。Tier S，席位落地。

席位意见：接受。纯搬移，形状与第 20–32 刀相同；普查从第 32 刀的 89 到本刀的 90，是 main 自己的变化（正文已说明，读数取自 main），不是本 PR 带来的。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#1 · head 044b4d97de892c2ad6277961ee43b27a56f1dd0d · 2026-10-29T12:08Z

- **Shape:** move-only cut, #23050 shape B (host object + `fn.call(host, …)`; no-`this` bodies call the function directly). 22 members into 8 modules; every class member keeps name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position; no call site changes. Seat spot-read of the `protocol.ts` import block and stub markers (30 `[#25467 cut 33]` lines in the diff) and the `PRODUCERS` hunk.
- **Premise:** the claim 6489357157 holds on this head; `Part of #25467`, `Ruling-ref: 6270097840`.
- **Gates:** 53 check-runs on this head: 34 success, 19 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `check-expected-skips --pr 27540` (from a fresh `origin/main` checkout): `VERDICT … OK — 19 skipped check-run(s), every one in main's roster (exit 0)`. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Contract review:** not owed. `check-governed-merges --pr 27540`: `NOT governed`, 0 of 10 paths on the register; `Clause-②: no` (no export or accept-set change; `.d.ts` byte-identical per the PR's measurement); no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed rule text, no narrowing.
- **Accepted deviations:** 4 new `PRODUCERS` rows in `protocol.bracketed-refusal-opener-absence.test.ts`: the path-reader migration the split ruling requires (the 5 moved `new Error(` sites keep their family's floor); `protocol.ts`'s own floor of 5 still stands. Two top-level helpers exported in place from their new modules, not reachable from the package's published entry types.
- **Declaration:** `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` (internal move, nothing published changes).
- **Out of scope:** the private-member line of the series is spent (40 members screened and rejected, reasons tabled in the PR body). The next cut needs a pin-migration ruling or a public-member shape plan; recorded on #25467 at release. **Skills-docs:** none.
- **Landing:** Tier S, 1,294 changed lines ≤ 3000 → `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` via the relay now; on merge, #25467 goes back to `pm:queue` with a delivered/remaining note.
